newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIA PALM OLEIN HIGHER IN ACTIVE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIA PALM OLEIN HIGHER IN ACTIVE TRADE.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices drove higher in early trading on Thursday as buyers crowded the market amid tight supply due to rising exports, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,460-65 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, compared with 1,445-50 rupiah at Wednesday's close. A crude pam oil tender is scheduled for Friday.

"Prices are continuing to go higher because of the good demand," one trader said. "Supply of ready palm olein is tight, and is expected to get tighter because prices in Europe are getting better and exports will increase," she added.
Most traders had closed early on Wednesday in anticipation of gains on Thursday.
The traders said Indonesian exports have become more competitive because of a lowering in the export tax on palm olein last month under the economic deregulation package.
European September palm olein offers rose $5.00 a tonne to $530.00 fob Malaysia overnight.
